source_notes: PROVISIONAL: copied from 2025. Update when CRA publishes 2026 figures (prescribed rate, CCA phase-out, provincial rates).

corporate_tax.notes: Estimates only - passive income grinds and associated-corp sharing of the SBD limit are the accountant's call.

dividends.notes: Non-eligible = paid from income taxed at the small-business rate (the normal case for an owner-operator CCPC). Eligible requires GRIP balance - confirm with the accountant before declaring.

t5.filing_deadline: Last day of February following the calendar year of payment

shareholder_loan.notes: ITA 15(2): a shareholder debit balance not repaid within one year after the corporation's year-end is included in the shareholder's income. ITA 80.4: imputed interest at the prescribed rate applies while outstanding. Prescribed rate changes quarterly - keep updated.

10.1.description: Passenger vehicles over the cost cap

cca.notes: first_year_multiplier 1.5 = Accelerated Investment Incentive on net additions (phases out after 2027; was immediate expensing for CCPCs before 2024). Set to 0.5 to model the plain half-year rule.

oilfield_deductions.camp_allowance_notes: Camp/board provided at remote work sites is generally 100% deductible to the corporation (not a taxable benefit at special work sites per ITA 6(6)).
oilfield_deductions.safety_gear_notes: PPE required for site access (FR clothing, H2S monitors, boots) is 100% deductible.
oilfield_deductions.remote_work_notes: Travel to special/remote work sites, lodging and reasonable allowances are deductible - keep site tickets as support.
